dashboard.when: see the overview: what is in tanks, what is arriving, what needs release

ama.when: ask a question in full conversation form

settings-2fa.when: enrol or disable an authenticator app

settings-client.when: change the organization name, display units, time zone

settings-mcp-tokens.when: connect their own AI tools: see the MCP URLs, create or revoke a token

activity-list.when: browse the activity log (read only; the activity server answers the questions)

premises-add.when: add or change a premises (permit kind, registry number, filing frequency) — the empty form for a new one

premises-edit.when: add or change a premises (permit kind, registry number, filing frequency) — the form for an existing record

locations-list.when: see where stock can be kept

location-add.when: add or change a storage location and its tax state — the empty form for a new one

location-edit.when: add or change a storage location and its tax state — the form for an existing record

vessels-list.when: see tanks, totes and barrels and their status

vessel-add.when: add or change a vessel — the empty form for a new one

vessel-edit.when: add or change a vessel — the form for an existing record

items-list.when: browse everything that can be stocked

item-add.when: add or change an item (class, unit, lot control, quarantine default, reorder point); `kind=material` adds a material from Inventory, Materials — the empty form for a new one

item-edit.when: add or change an item (class, unit, lot control, quarantine default, reorder point); `kind=material` adds a material from Inventory, Materials — the form for an existing record

item-view.when: see an item's stock, lots, alternate units, suppliers

item-classes-list.when: see or manage the item classes (material types): material or finished product, purchasable, recipe ingredient

item-class-add.when: add a material type or change a class's name, flags or order — the empty form for a new one

item-class-edit.when: add a material type or change a class's name, flags or order — the form for an existing record

suppliers-list.when: see vendors (suppliers) and orchards, under Purchasing

supplier-add.when: add or change a supplier — the empty form for a new one

supplier-edit.when: add or change a supplier — the form for an existing record

supplier-view.when: see a supplier's items, prices, orders and performance

users-list.when: see who can sign in (owner only)

user-add.when: invite a user or change a role — the empty form for a new one

user-edit.when: invite a user or change a role — the form for an existing record

reason-codes-list.when: see or manage reason codes and their TTB categories

reason-code-add.when: add or change a reason code — the empty form for a new one

reason-code-edit.when: add or change a reason code — the form for an existing record

purchase-orders-list.when: see open, overdue, or past purchase orders, under Purchasing

purchase-order-add.when: create or change an order with its lines — the empty form for a new one

purchase-order-edit.when: create or change an order with its lines — the form for an existing record

purchase-order-view.when: see an order, its lines, what has been received against it

receipts-list.when: see deliveries received or in progress

receipt-add.when: record a delivery: lines, quantities, lot numbers, weigh tags, discrepancies — the empty form for a new one

receipt-edit.when: record a delivery: lines, quantities, lot numbers, weigh tags, discrepancies — the form for an existing record

receipt-view.when: see a posted receipt and the lots it created

receipts-projected.when: see a calendar of when shipments are expected, from the expected dates on open purchase orders

lots-list.when: find lots by item, status, expiry

lot-view.when: see a lot: balances by location, attributes, CoA values, release history

lot-edit.when: change a lot's expiry, supplier lot number, attributes

lot-coa-add.when: attach a CoA and enter its values

lot-release.when: release, hold, or reject a lot with a basis

putaway.when: move a receipt's lots from the dock to storage

inventory-materials.when: see what materials are on hand (fruit, juice, yeast, additives, packaging, intermediates) by item, lot, location, with available and allocated

inventory-finished.when: see what finished product is on hand by item, lot, location, with available and allocated

inventory-movements.when: see the ledger history for an item, lot, or location

reorder-list.when: see what is below reorder point and on order

rack-board.when: see which product, lot and batch is on each numbered rack; find where a product is stored

rack-fifo.when: see which lot to pick or use next, oldest first, and the rack it is on

tank-view.when: see the tanks as they stand on the floor and how much each holds (juice, fermenting, base cider, finished); arrange them by dragging

rack-add.when: add or change a numbered rack in a storage area — the empty form for a new one

rack-edit.when: add or change a numbered rack in a storage area — the form for an existing record

adjustments-list.when: see inventory adjustments and their reasons

count-add.when: start a count of a location

count-view.when: enter counted quantities, review variances, approve

product-add.when: add or change a product (style, target ABV, fruit share, intended tax class) — the empty form for a new one

product-edit.when: add or change a product (style, target ABV, fruit share, intended tax class) — the form for an existing record

product-view.when: see a product: recipe versions, packaging, specs, approvals, batches

recipe-add.when: create or edit a draft recipe: stages, expected losses, lines — the empty form for a new one

recipe-edit.when: create or edit a draft recipe: stages, expected losses, lines — the form for an existing record

recipe-view.when: see a version, scale it, compare with another, activate it

packaging-config-add.when: define a package: finished item, fill volume, bill of materials, expected loss — the empty form for a new one

packaging-config-edit.when: define a package: finished item, fill volume, bill of materials, expected loss — the form for an existing record

specs-list.when: see or edit acceptable ranges per stage for a product

spec-add.when: add or change a spec — the empty form for a new one

spec-edit.when: add or change a spec — the form for an existing record

standard-costs-list.when: see and set standard costs and the overhead rate

standard-cost-add.when: set a standard cost for an item

approvals-list.when: see formula and label approvals and what is missing

approval-add.when: record a formula or label approval — the empty form for a new one

approval-edit.when: record a formula or label approval — the form for an existing record

production-orders-list.when: see planned, released, and in-progress orders

production-order-add.when: plan a batch: product, recipe, volume, dates, vessels — the empty form for a new one

production-order-edit.when: plan a batch: product, recipe, volume, dates, vessels — the form for an existing record

production-order-view.when: see an order, its material check, vessel conflicts, allocations; release or close it

production-calendar.when: see planned vessel use over time and spot conflicts

press-run-add.when: record a press: fruit lots in, juice lots out, pomace, vessel — the empty form for a new one

press-run-edit.when: record a press: fruit lots in, juice lots out, pomace, vessel — the form for an existing record

press-run-view.when: see a press run, its yield, post it

tank-board.when: see what is in every vessel right now

batch-add.when: start a batch by pitching yeast into juice

batch-view.when: see a batch: stage, vessel, readings curve, consumptions, losses, lineage, cost

batch-edit.when: change a batch's notes or tax class override

batch-reading-add.when: record a reading (Brix, SG, pH, SO2, temperature, ABV, CO2)

batch-addition-add.when: add an ingredient (nutrient, sulfite, enzyme, sweetener, acid) by lot

batch-stage-move.when: move the batch to the next stage with volume out

batch-transfer.when: move the batch to another vessel

batch-split.when: split the batch into several vessels

batch-blend-add.when: blend batches into a new one

batch-loss-add.when: record a loss with a reason

yeast-harvest-add.when: harvest yeast from the batch into a new lot

packaging-run-add.when: package a batch: configuration, volume in, units out, CO2, materials — the empty form for a new one

packaging-run-edit.when: package a batch: configuration, volume in, units out, CO2, materials — the form for an existing record

packaging-run-view.when: see a run, its loss, finished lots, tax class; post it

finished-lots-list.when: see what is packaged and ready, by product, package, location

finished-lot-view.when: see a finished lot: batch, tax class check, removals, kegs

kegs-list.when: see the keg fleet by state and holder

keg-add.when: register or change a keg — the empty form for a new one

keg-edit.when: register or change a keg — the form for an existing record

keg-view.when: see a keg's history; fill, return, clean, mark lost

keg-return.when: scan or type returned keg serials

lab-list.when: see recent readings and out-of-spec results

lab-reading-add.when: record a lab test on a batch or lot

batch-release.when: release a batch for packaging with the readings it was based on, or override with a reason

report-yields.when: see per-stage yield and loss by batch or product

report-juice-yield.when: see gallons per ton and per bushel by variety

report-batch-costs.when: see cost per batch, per liter, per keg and case, variance

report-valuation.when: see inventory value by class and tax state

customer-add.when: add or change a customer — the empty form for a new one

customer-edit.when: add or change a customer — the form for an existing record

customer-view.when: see a customer's removals and kegs out

removals-list.when: see finished goods that left, by destination

removal-add.when: record finished goods leaving: destination, lots, units, kegs — the empty form for a new one

removal-edit.when: record finished goods leaving: destination, lots, units, kegs — the form for an existing record

removal-view.when: see a removal and its tax determination; post or reverse it

return-add.when: record goods coming back from a customer

ttb-report-view.when: see a report's lines, drill into the transactions behind a line, finalize, mark filed

trace.when: trace a lot forward or a batch backward for a recall

orders-list.when: see open or past customer orders, what is due, overdue orders

order-add.when: enter a customer order: customer, due date, lines of product format and units, prices — the empty form for a new one

order-edit.when: enter a customer order: customer, due date, lines of product format and units, prices — the form for an existing record

order-view.when: see an order's lines, packaging runs and shipments; confirm, package, ship, close or cancel it

order-package.when: create the draft packaging runs that fill an order

orders-package-format.when: package one format for every open order that needs it

orders-to-package.when: see what must be packaged for customer orders, by format and due date

standing-order-add.when: set up or change a recurring order (weekly, every few weeks, monthly) — the empty form for a new one

standing-order-edit.when: set up or change a recurring order (weekly, every few weeks, monthly) — the form for an existing record

standing-order-view.when: see a standing order's next dates; turn a date into an order; pause or resume it

orders-import.when: load past or upcoming orders from a spreadsheet (CSV or Excel)

order-import-view.when: see an import's preview, columns, result or errors; import, undo or discard it

planning.when: see demand by week and what to package, brew and buy

planning-production.when: see which batches to start and by when

planning-purchasing.when: see what to buy, how much and by when

planning-forecast.when: see and set forecast demand per format and week

report-orders.when: see past orders by customer, product, format or month
